recoveryIssues.detail: pg_dumpall --globals-only was refused; the required roles were captured from the database catalog instead (database/roles.sql).
recoveryIssues.action: none — restore.sh --roles recreates them; LOGIN roles need their passwords from the secret store.

prerequisites.note: LOGIN roles are recreated WITHOUT passwords — set them from the secret store; provider-managed roles must exist on the target or be mapped (restore.sh --role-map).
